Our client is an international organisation specialising in rail transport.

Jobomschrijving

Do you have a little experience in communications and you are looking for experience in an international environment? We're looking for you for a 5-month project (ASAP - Early October) !

Main mission 

The candidate will be responsible for assisting the Communication Officer in the creation and integration of content on their website.

Receive briefings and requests for content creation from the various stakeholders in the organisation

Plan the copy work and communicate clear deadlines to the stakeholders, taking into account potential back-and-forth and validation.

Create content in line with the Thalys tone of voice and internal processes, taking account of SEO constraints

Ensuring that the content is validated by the various stakeholders before being sent to the translators

Reviewing the content once it has been translated and integrating it into our CMS according to the production process

Profile 

Bilingual in French and English, both spoken and written

At least two years' experience in copywriting and content integration in drupal

Very good knowledge of the CMS

Good knowledge of digital marketing, copywriting and SEO

Personality: customer-oriented, creative, proactive, autonomous, good writing and communication skills, good organisational skills, team player

• Experience in Production Planning 
• Experience within FMCG is a big plus
• Good SAP knowledge

jobs.occupation: Chauffeur CE( kooiaap/ kraan/ Haakwagen/ plateauwagen)
jobs.description:
Do you hold a CE driving licence and and Code 95 ? Then you might be the person we are looking for!
 

In this role, you will deliver various materials with your truck (and unload them yourself) at construction sites or at customers’ premises.
 

 
• You transport goods correctly and safely to the customer.
 
• You load and unload the goods independently using your truck-mounted forklift.
 
• You work closely together with the transport planner.
 
• You communicate correctly and in a friendly manner with customers and ensure accurate administrative follow-up. 

 
• You hold a valid CE driving licence and Code 95.
 
• You can communicate fluently in Dutch, French, or English.
 
• You take care of the equipment you work with.
 
• You are a reliable driver with a strong focus on safety.
 
• You are polite and helpful towards customers.
 
• You remain calm and courteous in traffic.
 
• You are punctual, including with administrative tasks (CMRs, trip sheets, etc.).
 
• You are responsible and able to work independently.

Reporting and service data management: 

 
• bull;    Provide timely and accurate reporting based on service tickets. 
 
• bull;    Search, verify and consolidate the relevant information contained in tickets. 
 
• bull;    Prepare SLA reports, KPI reports, dashboards and clear management information. 
 
• bull;    Ensure the quality, completeness, consistency and currency of reporting data. 
Reporting process improvement and automation: 

 
• bull;    Improve and automate the current reporting processes, which are still partly manual. 
 
• bull;    Use advanced Microsoft Excel functionalities to optimize data processing and reporting. 
 
• bull;    Identify automation opportunities using Power Automate and, where relevant, VBA. 
 
• bull;    Maintain dashboards and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives. 
Service Delivery support: 

 
• bull;    Support the Services Delivery team with administrative and analytical tasks. 
 
• bull;    Translate operational data into accurate and understandable information for internal stakeholders and management. 
 
• bull;    Organize and prioritize tasks independently, while respecting reporting deadlines and quality requirements. 
 
• bull;    Take on other related tasks when required, while reporting remains the priority of the role. 
KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS 

 
• bull;    Timely delivery of SLA and management reports. 
 
• bull;    Accuracy and quality of reporting data. 
 
• bull;    Level of automation achieved in reporting processes. 
 
• bull;    Availability and currency of dashboards. 
 
• bull;    Internal customer satisfaction regarding reporting. 
 
• bull;    Number and quality of identified improvement initiatives. 
 

 Education, Knowledge & Work Experience: 

 
• bull;    Relevant higher education or ongoing studies in office management, business management, administration, data analysis or a related field. 
 
• bull;    Strong knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including PivotTables, advanced formulas, data modelling and dashboarding. 
 
• bull;    Strong analytical skills and experience with data analysis. 
 
• bull;    Experience with KPI development, SLA reporting and data quality management is an asset. 
 
• bull;    Knowledge of ITIL processes and experience with CMDB environments are assets. 
 
• bull;    Experience with Power Automate, VBA, Grafana or similar tools is an asset. 
Required skills: 

 
• bull;    Strong analytical mindset and administrative accuracy.

• bull;    Ability to work independently and to prioritize tasks. 
 
• bull;    Results-oriented and quality-focused approach.
